name: 0.125mm CCF + Matrix @P3
description: P3 mixed printing on common 0.125 mm layers: thermoplastic matrix on T4 (PA-CF by default), continuous fiber on T5. Material temperatures and feed calibration remain owned by their material and machine presets. One fiber contour per eligible layer, 1 mm provisional deposited width, 15% matrix infill and five solid layers at each end. Ironed thickness and machine execution require physical validation.
